items.meaning: One bounded Goal together with its declared intent, scope, and named Work Owner.
items.absence_behavior: Block and ask for the missing Goal, intent, scope, or owner; never infer a consequential purpose.

items.meaning: One current CAV2-D66 Context that fixes Product, Project, Goal, purpose, consumer, Bounded Context, and source-policy boundaries.
items.absence_behavior: Block Definition Pack construction until the Context is available and its identity is preserved.

items.meaning: Relevant current repository evidence and prior evidence records for the bounded Goal, including explicit notice of unavailable, stale, ambiguous, or conflicting evidence.
items.absence_behavior: Expose the missing evidence and block any next use that cannot accept the named gap.

items.meaning: The bounded set of concepts required by the Goal and intended next use, with any uncertainty about the set visible.
items.absence_behavior: Stop before claiming coverage and ask what the next use needs to understand.

items.meaning: Known meaning owners, decision owners, consumer owner, challenge routes, and explicit authority limits.
items.absence_behavior: Keep ownership unresolved and prevent promotion or consequential selection.

items.meaning: A current Language Context View when the bounded context has registered language bindings relevant to the Goal.
items.absence_behavior: Expose the language gap and avoid inventing equivalence, realization, ownership, or permission.

owner_routes: Owner of the named intended use
challenge_route: Challenge an input through its source owner; challenge the required-input set through the Define capability owner and the owner of the intended next use.
claim_limit: This contract defines required meaning-bearing input; it does not prove that any runtime retrieves all relevant evidence or interprets it correctly.
